name: Strength
meaning_for_today: Today requires patience, courage, emotional balance, and inner resilience. Gentle persistence and self-control will help overcome challenges successfully.
card_advice: Trust your inner strength rather than force or aggression. Stay calm, patient, and confident while handling difficult situations or emotions.

upright.short: Inner strength, courage, patience, self-control, compassion.
upright.general: Strength represents courage, emotional balance, resilience, and the ability to overcome obstacles through patience and inner power. This card symbolizes confidence, self-discipline, compassion, and mastery over instincts or fears.
upright.in_love: In relationships, Strength signifies trust, emotional maturity, loyalty, and deep mutual support. It reflects a stable connection built on patience, understanding, and compassion.
upright.in_situation: The situation requires calm determination and emotional control. Success will come through patience, confidence, and gentle persistence rather than forceful action.

reversed.general: Reversed, Strength may indicate insecurity, lack of confidence, emotional instability, fear, or difficulty controlling impulses. It can point to frustration, exhaustion, or inner conflict.
reversed.in_love: In love readings, the reversed Strength card may suggest jealousy, insecurity, emotional tension, or imbalance in the relationship. Patience and honest communication are needed.
reversed.in_situation: The situation may feel overwhelming due to fear, stress, or lack of confidence. The card advises rebuilding inner stability and avoiding impulsive reactions.
